text:
Priya Rao: checking in on the postmortem action items from pm-2026-02-model-fallbacks. doc still shows 4 OPENs. need owners, ETAs, and acceptance criteria by EOD or I'll escalate to Eng leads. link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/pm-2026-02-model-fallbacks

Priya Rao: snapshot pasted: 
1) add explicit model-fallback policy in router - owner: Kyle - due 2026-03-18 - OPEN
2) add end-to-end chaos tests for rollout - owner: Ivy - due 2026-03-20 - OPEN
3) instrument per-route cost telemetry - owner: Sanjay - due 2026-03-17 - OPEN
4) update runbook for degraded-model mode - owner: Kyle - due 2026-03-16 - OPEN

Kyle Park: saw this. I'm owner on 1 & 4. 1 needs design review with runtime team; I can finish a draft by 2026-03-23. 4 is lower effort, can land by 2026-03-19 if nothing blocks.

Ivy Gomez: chaos tests rely on the test-harness infra work (blocked on infra quota). I filed INF-993 last week. ETA for me once infra is available: 2026-03-27.

Sanjay Mehta: cost telemetry: starting a small spike today to validate overhead. aiming for an initial PR by 2026-03-20. will need ack from billing for schema.

Priya Rao: @Sanjay can you loop in billing? last time schema drift caused delays. @Kyle please add acceptance criteria for 1 & 4 (e.g., fallback invoked <1% of calls in canary for 72h + unit tests).

Kyle Park: adding acceptance criteria now. draft: "PR + e2e canary showing fallback behavior exercised with expected latency delta <200ms for 72h". updating doc.

ops-bot: automated reminder: 4 OPEN action items in pm-2026-02-model-fallbacks. Next reminder in 48h.

Ivy Gomez: pinging infra: INF-993 is still unassigned. any update? I can repurpose a dev cluster if quota won't free up.

Sanjay Mehta: billing engaged. BIN-2105 created to approve telemetry schema. asked for example payloads.

Priya Rao: fine to repurpose dev cluster temporarily, Ivy, but capture drift in notes. also, if INF-993 isn't picked up, @Sanjay can we table the telemetry to a follow-up and prioritize the router fallback + runbook?

Sanjay Mehta: yes, we can split. will scope telemetry MVP to avoid billing backlog and aim for 2026-03-24 for the MVP PR.

Kyle Park: quick status: started design doc for fallback routing: https://docs.internal/redwood/routing/fallback-design. will request runtime review tomorrow. changing status to IN PROGRESS in the postmortem doc.

Priya Rao: thanks. heads up I'll be escalating to Eng leads tomorrow morning if items don't have concrete ETAs. trying to avoid that but we need closure.

ops-bot: automated: thread update detected  3 OPEN action items remaining.

Ivy Gomez: repurposed dev cluster workaround worked. I started the chaos test harness and pushed WIP here: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pulls/9150. still flaky but progressing.

Sanjay Mehta: BIN-2105 approved for minimal telemetry fields. pushing PR today. marking #3 as IN PROGRESS.

Kyle Park: runtime review complete, small nits requested. I'll address and aim to merge by 2026-03-24. moving #1 to IN REVIEW.

Priya Rao: great progress. once PRs merge, post a short verification note (canary id or test run id) and I'll close those items. If anyone expects slippage, call it out now so I can reassign before escalation.

Ivy Gomez: minor slippage on chaos tests due to flaky harness, new ETA 2026-03-29. updated doc and added acceptance: reproducible failure injection + recovery within 5m in staging runs 3/3.

Kyle Park: PR merged for fallback routing. canary done: canary-2026-03-24-14 with 0.6% fallback invocation and <150ms median latency delta. posted logs to doc. Marking #1 DONE.

Sanjay Mehta: telemetry PR merged. basic per-route cost fields are live in staging; will roll to prod next week after a quick validation sweep. marking #3 IN REVIEW.

Priya Rao: verified canary logs for #1. closing item #1. Ivy, keep pushing on #2 and mark #4 as DONE once the updated runbook is in the docs with acceptance criteria.

ops-bot: automated: final reminder: 1 OPEN action item remains.

Ivy Gomez: chaos tests now green in staging. upload test artifacts and linking PR: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pulls/9168. marking #2 DONE.

Priya Rao: all items verified and closed. thanks for the quick follow-ups. I'll file a brief note to Eng leads summarizing closure and the recurring action to run fallback drills quarterly. :white_check_mark:
